title: OpenClaw for Solopreneurs: Replace a VA With One AI Agent
summary: How solopreneurs use OpenClaw to handle lead research, client communications, content drafting, reporting, and follow-ups — without hiring a virtual assistant.
body_markdown: A VA has judgment, builds relationships, can attend events, and handles nuanced situations. OpenClaw handles volume, consistency, and speed — researching 50 leads, drafting 20 follow-ups, generating 4 client reports — at any hour, without taking days off. The best solopreneur setups use both: OpenClaw handles the repeatable, data-heavy work; a part-time human VA handles the judgment-heavy work. Total cost: from about $45/month per agent plus model usage (Blink Claw) + $400-600/month (10 hours/week VA) replaces what would have been $1,500-2,000/month for a full-time VA.
